bull.probability_evidence: Trend intact: 50-day MA +7.9% above 200-day, price +3.1% above 200-day, RSI(14) 40.2 inside the pullback band (factsheet Price section); Ross is gaining traffic share from rivals as shoppers trade down (Barron's 2026-09-18, cited in note sec.1); the 2026-08-20 beat-and-raise quarter (Reuters) plus TTM ROIC 33.6% and FCF margin rising to 11.4% (factsheet Quality) back the continuation of the 12-month uptrend (evaluation Bull case).

target_band.cite: Valuation anchors disagree at the 'bull' re-rate level: P/FCF 5y-median 28.7x on FCF/share (225.53/25.8) implies 250.93 (= the evaluator's own bull target); P/E 5y-median 25.8x on EPS (225.53/27.3) implies ~213.0; EV/EBITDA 5y-median 18.0x (scaled off current 19.8x, net debt only 0.12x EBITDA so EV~=market cap, factsheet Quality) implies ~205.0. Half the spread (250.93-205.0)/2=22.95, / target 250.9 = 0.0915. factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table.

base.probability_evidence: Evaluator's own rationale: 'the setup passes the mechanical filters, but the edge is unclear' -- price has already broken below the post-earnings swing low (228.05) with lower highs/lows, and 6-month relative strength is -17.4pp vs SPY (evaluation Decision rationale and Bear case), making continuation of the current range the single most likely outcome.

target_band.cite: The base case is explicitly an offset the evaluator names: 'P/FCF below its 5y min (25.8x vs 27.6x) offsets EV/EBITDA above its 5y max (19.8x vs 19.3x)' (evaluation Decision rationale/base basis). Pricing each side of that named offset: EV/EBITDA reverting to its own 5y max 19.3x (scaled off current 19.8x) implies ~219.83; P/FCF reverting to its own 5y min 27.6x on FCF/share implies ~241.19; P/E flat at current 27.3x = 225.53. Half the spread (241.19-219.83)/2=10.68, / target 225.5 = 0.0473. factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table.

bear.probability_evidence: Macro overlay's small tilt toward bear (real 10y yield +48bp/1m, +61bp/3m, a persistent 3-month rise; sector rotation into staples per ETF Trends 2026-09-22 cited in the factsheet) combined with ROST's multiple already 108-148% through its own 5y range and +12-62% vs peers (factsheet Valuation), raising de-rating risk (evaluation Bear case; research/ROST/2026-10-08-macro.md macro_tilt).

target_band.cite: Valuation anchors disagree at the 'bear' peer-median level: P/E peer median 24.4x on EPS implies 201.56 (= the evaluator's own bear target); EV/EBITDA peer median 16.4x (scaled off current 19.8x) implies ~186.85; P/FCF peer median 26.0x on FCF/share implies ~227.27.
